statement: ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (V : ℕ → Set (YuiEucl (n + 1))), YuiCover δ (YuiCylinder E) V → ∀ (J : ℕ → Set ℝ), (∀ i, YuiLast '' V i ⊆ J i) → ∀ t ∈ YuiI, YuiContent s δ E ≤ ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (Metric.ediam (V i)) ^ s) t
proof:
classical
intro s δ hs V hV J hJ t ht
let W : ℕ → Set (YuiEucl n) := fun i => if t ∈ J i then YuiHead '' V i else ∅
have hd (i : ℕ) : Metric.ediam (YuiHead '' V i) ≤ Metric.ediam (V i) := by
  simpa using (h_T003 n).2.2.2.1.ediam_image_le (V i)
have hc : YuiCover δ E W := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    have hxt : YuiSnoc x t ∈ YuiCylinder E := by
      change YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) ∈ E ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) ∈ YuiI
      rw [(h_T003 n).1 x t |>.1, (h_T003 n).1 x t |>.2]
      exact ⟨hx, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hV.1 hxt)
    have hj : t ∈ J i := by
      have := hJ i (Set.mem_image_of_mem YuiLast hi)
      simpa only [(h_T003 n).1 x t |>.2] using this
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    dsimp [W]
    rw [if_pos hj]
    exact ⟨YuiSnoc x t, hi, (h_T003 n).1 x t |>.1⟩
  · intro i
    dsimp [W]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (hd i).trans (hV.2 i)
    · simpa using (zero_le (ENNReal.ofReal δ))
calc
  YuiContent s δ E ≤ YuiCost s W := iInf_le_of_le W (iInf_le_of_le hc le_rfl)
  _ ≤ ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (Metric.ediam (V i)) ^ s) t := by
    apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
    intro i
    by_cases hi : t ∈ J i
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hi]
      apply iSup_le
      intro hne
      dsimp [W]
      rw [if_pos hi]
      exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hd i) hs.le
    · simp [W, hi]

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
      ∀ (s δ : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          ∀ (V : ℕ → Set (YuiEucl (n + 1))),
            YuiCover δ (YuiCylinder E) V →
              ∀ (J : ℕ → Set ℝ),
                (∀ (i : ℕ), YuiLast '' V i ⊆ J i) →
                  ∀ t ∈ YuiI, YuiContent s δ E ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i).indicator (fun x => Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s) t
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
